text:
maria: Hey team — need to swap my Sun 18:00-00:00 oncall. Family thing, out that evening. Can someone cover? I can trade a Sat morning slot or take a Tues evening later. Sorry for the late ask :disappointed:
ashwin: I can take Sun 18:00-20:00. @kevin can you finish 20:00-00:00? I can do full if neither can but prefer split. Need prewarm notes though.
kevin: I can do 20:00-00:00. @maria can you paste any running jobs / known risks? I'll run the prewarm script before I start.
maria: Thanks — no planned deploys. Long job to be aware of: nightly-embeddings (should be killed by 17:00). Quick prewarm steps: run staging health check + KV warm script. Snippet:
```bash
# from infra-tools repo
./scripts/warm_kv.sh --models all --limit 3
curl -s https://staging.redwood.internal/health
```
I'll add handoff notes in the runbook: endpoints to check, alert thresholds, and model flakiness notes.
sam: I can also cover the whole shift if you want me to, no problem :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Reminder — if you're doing a partial swap update the schedule and add a handoff note: `/oncall swap maria -> ashwin 2168901234 2168904700` and add entry to https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff
ashwin: Cool. @kevin confirm you can take 20:00-00:00? If yes I'll update the schedule and add the prewarm step to the runbook.
kevin: Confirmed. I'll run `warm_kv.sh` at ~17:50 and watch token usage for the first hour. If any models look flaky ping me and I'll roll back routing to model-v1.
maria: Done — added runbook note: "no deploys, nightly-embeddings terminated at 17:00, run `./scripts/warm_kv.sh` from infra-tools at ~17:50, alert thresholds 5xx > 3%". Thanks all :raised_hands:
oncall-bot: Schedule updated: maria -> ashwin (18:00-20:00) -> kevin (20:00-00:00). Schedule link: https://schedules.redwood.internal/rotation/eng-oncall/2168901234
ashwin: :thumbsup: I'll post a brief "handoff complete" at 19:58 after checks.
sam: If anything changes ping me, I'll be on standby.
maria: Appreciate it. Leaving phone on — DM me if urgent before 18:00. —m
